name: M5.Packing.equal_residue_tag_strict
statement: ∀ (w T : ℕ) (r : Fin w → Fin T) (i j : Fin w), i < j → r i = r j → M5.Packing.occurrenceTag r i < M5.Packing.occurrenceTag r j
guidance: Show priorOccurrences r i is a strict subset of priorOccurrences r j. Earlier matching indices remain earlier and matching by equality of residues, while i belongs only to the latter set. Apply Finset.card_lt_card. This is the key to separating repeated residues. Return only tactic lines without a leading by. Preserve the exact target.
